text: The TripAgent Flight database service is available.

The TripAgent Flight database holds 12 flight records covering 7 routes operated by 7 airlines. Airlines: Air New Zealand, Japan Airlines, Jetstar, Qantas, Scoot, Singapore Airlines, Virgin Australia. Routes: MEL-SYD, SYD-AKL, SYD-BNE, SYD-HND, SYD-MEL, SYD-PER, SYD-SIN.
Flight fares in the TripAgent Flight database range from $98.00 to $1385.00.
TripAgent Flight Search allows travellers to browse, search and filter flight records by origin airport and destination airport.
The Flight Search Service supports full create, read, update and delete operations on flight records through its frontend and backend API.

A flight with fewer than ten seats remaining is reported as limited availability. If seat availability is not recorded, the system returns an unknown availability status rather than assuming the flight is full.

Flight recommendations follow a Plan, Act, Observe, Adapt workflow. The Observe stage verifies retrieved flight data deterministically in code, computing the price and duration ranges and identifying the cheapest and quickest flights before the language model is called.

The Flight Search language model may only describe flights returned by the flight database query. It must not invent airlines, routes, prices or times, and the verified flight table is displayed alongside every generated recommendation.
A flight is uniquely identified by its airline, origin, destination and departure time. Creating a duplicate returns an HTTP 409 conflict rather than a second record.
